front.title: Evaluation Profiles for AI Agent Security Assessment

abstract.t: This document defines evaluation profiles for the security assessment of AI agents. A profile fixes the System Under Test boundary and the scenario against which the metrics defined in [I-D.han-bpm-agent-security-benchmark-terminology] are applied, so that results obtained under different boundaries or scenarios are not compared without qualification. The document defines four infrastructure profiles, which correspond to the four component groups of an agent and to the four evaluation dimensions; six scenario profiles, which correspond to the agent types in scope; the input and output boundary specification that applies to all profiles; profile composition rules; and the minimum evaluation logging fields required by each profile. The metric definitions are the subject of [I-D.han-bpm-agent-security-benchmark-terminology], and the methods by which the metrics are exercised are the subject of [I-D.han-bpm-agent-security-benchmark-methodology].
